details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 65% of the 408 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 57%). 61 problems keep coming back; 58 have a card to fix the cause, 3 more get one over the next days. 5 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. 1 problem came back after the card fixing the cause was closed. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 8 of 8 fixed the cause.

details.name: Improvement: done claims that held
details.message: Done claims that held: 93% (792 of 854) over 30 days, 91% (220 of 241) over 7 days; 11 more could not be checked on the recheck machine. On the first independent check: 88% (759 of 859).
